scope: Recorded full-split text benchmark results; one training seed and evaluation seed 42; no significance or published-score equivalence claim

metric_definitions.acc,none: Accuracy using unnormalized continuation log likelihood.
metric_definitions.acc_norm,none: Harness length-normalized continuation accuracy, when provided; not interchangeable with acc,none.
metric_definitions.*_stderr,none: Original harness standard errors, not across-training-seed uncertainty.

protocol_caveat: SFT/DPO ran locally; CISPO/GRPO ran on a server. Harness version, evaluator, loader, model and tokenizer hashes agree, but installed harness source hashes differ. No bitwise environment-equivalence claim.

dataset_loading.normalization: none; upstream pandas read_csv and datasets feature conversion
